resources.string: Allows MetaRemake to present Android apps as surfaces inside the Cardboard VR environment and to forward your hand/controller input to them. It never modifies or injects code into other apps — it only uses the standard Android accessibility APIs you authorize.
The captured frame is rendered as a surface inside the Cardboard environment.
The camera is used for the Mixed Reality environment and for the hand tracking demo.
Overlay windows are used to host the VR control strip.
Enable the MetaRemake accessibility service to use Android apps inside VR.
